**Dispatch:** PGE-OUT-5001 (truck RLT-088, loaded 39,000 kg from North House 12 on 2025-09-04)

**Mill run:** **MILL-2206** — used HFM-IN-601 as input; output batch FEED-2206 (starter feed).

The dispatch was linked to HFM-IN-601 via carrier manifest RL-8841 (cargo mark PGE-OUT-5001 matched to mill bill reference RL-5001-A).
